question: which sparse features of the FlexiCT representations used by the selected classifiers, and of the text-aligned final layer of the FlexiCT-3D-VLM image encoder on the official whole-CT window, reappear across seeds, keep the classifier output and exceed a random-weight encoder of the same architecture

f32_b10.head: heads/flexict_3d/f32_b10
f32_b10.context: selected FlexiCT-3D classifier: 32 mm field, 48^3 at 0.67 mm, patch tokens after block 10 of 16 with the final norm, all 216 tokens read by a max head

f40_b08.head: heads/flexict_vlm/f40_b08
f40_b08.context: selected FlexiCT-3D-VLM image-encoder classifier: 40 mm field, 48^3 at 0.83 mm, patch tokens after block 8 of 16 with the final norm, all 216 tokens read by a max head

w20_b16.head: heads/flexict_vlm/w20_b16
w20_b16.context: text-aligned final layer: official CT-RATE whole-CT window (2.0 mm, 160^3 centre crop), patch tokens after block 16 with the final norm; the VLM image embedding is the bias-free linear projection of [class token, mean patch token]; the classifier reads the 3^3 tokens nearest the nodule

records: train and development nodules of suite 20261019_flexict_luna25 (official LUNA25 CTs, AutoMSC-cleaned 6,132-nodule set, FLARE folds); one record per nodule for the field sites and one record per official 2.0 mm window (scan) for w20_b16; the test fold is not used
distance: signed distance in mm from each token centre (patch centre) to the surface of the target nodule component of the FLARE mask (negative inside); for w20_b16 the distance to the nearest annotated nodule surface of the scan

random_encoder.initialization: FlexiCT backbone built with the official arguments, then init_weights() under torch.manual_seed(20261014); evaluation mode; the same inputs, views, blocks and final norm as the trained encoders

sampling.w20_rule: per official window 1,024 uniformly sampled token positions (seeded by the scan) form the uniform matrices; tokens within stored_near_mm of a nodule surface are stored separately for the nodule pools and the coverage regions

grid_extension.rule: added 2026-10-21 after the grid evaluation and before any extension run: when no grid k meets the k rule at a site, that site's grid continues with k 64 and 128 (same expansion, steps and seeds); the k rule then applies to the extended grid; w20_b16 joined after the k_revision
grid_extension.reason: f32_b10 and f40_b08 failed at k 8-32; reconstruction raised development probabilities on average (+0.02 and +0.08 at k16), because the max head takes the maximum over 216 projected tokens and unstructured reconstruction error biases that maximum upwards; keeping the 10% or 25% lowest-scale channels original did not remove the shift, while larger k lowered it (f32_b10 MAE 0.033, 0.029, 0.023 at k 8, 16, 32)

acceptance_revision.rule: max_probability_mae and max_auroc_decrease on every seed; max_ap_decrease on the mean AP decrease over the 8 seeds; a reference-seed screen checks MAE and AUROC only, and a configuration is ruled out as soon as an evaluated seed fails MAE or AUROC, or when all 8 seeds are evaluated and the mean AP decrease exceeds the limit
acceptance_revision.decided: by the user on 2026-10-22 (10:2x EDT), after the fine-tuning results, choosing among: keep the per-seed AP limit, judge AP on the mean over the 8 seeds, or keep the gate and continue method work
acceptance_revision.reason: fine-tuned dictionaries passed MAE (0.009-0.019) on every seed and kept 440-820 stable features, while 1-4 of 8 seeds per configuration exceeded the per-seed AP limit (0.020-0.050); the development AP has a patient-bootstrap SD of about 0.06 (113 malignant), and retraining the deployed head with other seeds changes AP by up to 0.027; only from-scratch head-read dictionaries (41-56 stable features) passed the per-seed AP limit
acceptance_revision.scope: w20_b16 keeps the original per-seed gate, which its chosen k64 dictionaries pass on every seed

acceptance_roles.representation: max_development_fvu, min_mean_token_cosine, max_inactive_fraction and l0_relative_tolerance are reported diagnostics
acceptance_roles.selection_gate: max_probability_mae, max_auroc_decrease and max_ap_decrease when the dictionary reconstruction replaces every token read by the selected seed-2025 classifier head, on all development nodules

text_fidelity.prompts: present and absent prompt embeddings of run 20261018_vlm_text_check (official CT-RATE template, 9 concepts and 8 controls)
text_fidelity.rule: on the development official windows, every patch token is replaced by its reconstruction; the image embedding is recomputed with the stored class token; pass when the mean cosine between original and reconstructed image embeddings is at least 0.99 and the median Spearman correlation between original and reconstructed concept scores (present minus absent cosine, per phrase) is at least 0.90

downstream.loss: the usual BatchTopK token loss on the patient-balanced training matrix plus weight times the mean Bernoulli KL divergence between the deployed seed-2025 head's probabilities with original and with reconstructed tokens, on bag_records training nodules per step drawn patient-balanced; the head is frozen; reconstructions inside the loss use batch top-k, inference keeps the calibrated threshold
downstream.reference: end-to-end sparse dictionary learning (SAE_e2e): Braun et al., Identifying Functionally Important Features with End-to-End Sparse Dictionary Learning, 2024, arXiv 2405.12241 (docs/source_inventory_20260915.json)
downstream.rule: added 2026-10-21 after the extension of f32_b10 to k 64 and 128 failed the gate (AP decrease 0.015-0.066) and before any downstream run: for each site whose extended grid has no k meeting the k rule, train k 16 and 32 with weights 10 and 100 (8 seeds each); choose the smallest k, then the smallest weight, at which all 8 seeds pass the gate (and text fidelity); the gate is unchanged
downstream.random_control: random-weight dictionaries keep the token loss only, because the deployed head reads trained-encoder tokens
downstream.stopped: 2026-10-22, after the first f32_b10 k16 results and before any k32 or f40_b08 downstream run: the term fits the 3,729 training bags (reference dictionary at weight 10: training-bag probability MAE 0.001 against 0.065 without the term) while development MAE stays 0.025-0.028 and AP decrease 0.036-0.076, and the reference dictionary's head-space FVU rises from 0.52 to 1.42; the f32_b10 k16 runs (both weights, 8 seeds) are completed and kept, the 48 k32 and f40_b08 jobs were withdrawn unstarted (jobs_withdrawn/)

head_read.loss: the BatchTopK token loss plus weight times each of two terms, both through the deployed seed-2025 head's first linear layer after its per-channel standardization (864 -> 128, the values over which the max head takes its maximum): (1) head-space FVU of the token batch, the mean squared norm of each token's mapped reconstruction error divided by the variance of the training-matrix tokens under the map; (2) pooled FVU of bag_records training nodules per step drawn patient-balanced, the squared error of the 128 per-bag maxima with reconstructed tokens divided by the variance of the maxima over the training bags; the head is frozen; reconstructions inside the pooled term use batch top-k, inference keeps the calibrated threshold
head_read.screen: the reference seed is trained for every (k, weight); the other 7 seeds are trained for the smallest configuration (k, then weight) whose reference seed passes the gate, once every smaller configuration's screen is evaluated, and for the next such configuration as soon as an evaluated seed of the previous one fails (its unfinished seeds are withdrawn and their partial runs kept, completed ones are kept); this selects the same configuration as training the other seeds of every configuration whose reference seed passes
head_read.screen_revision: 2026-10-22 02:25 EDT, after the f32_b10 k32 and f40_b08 k16 screens and before any seed beyond the reference: the first wording trained the other seeds for every configuration whose reference seed passes; the f32_b10 k32 weight-3 seeds written under it stay in the queue and are withdrawn unstarted if a smaller f32_b10 configuration is chosen first
head_read.rule: added 2026-10-22 after the downstream objective was stopped and before any 48,000-step run of this objective: for each site without a qualifying k or downstream configuration, choose the smallest k, then the smallest weight, at which all 8 seeds pass the gate; the gate is unchanged
head_read.reason: the head reads directions that the token loss reconstructs poorly (development head-space FVU of the reference dictionaries 0.65 / 0.52 / 0.36 / 0.23 / 0.14 at f32_b10 k 8-128 and 0.57 / 0.45 / 0.34 / 0.24 / 0.15 at f40_b08, against overall FVU 0.29-0.05 and 0.22-0.03; at w20_b16, which passes, both are equal, k64 0.062 and 0.069), and the maximum over 216 tokens amplifies that error (pooled FVU 0.92 at f32_b10 k16 after 4,000 steps). In 4,000-step smokes at the reference seed the head-space term alone left MAE at 0.037-0.041; the pooled term alone gave MAE 0.017 but AP decrease 0.050 and moved error below the maximum (head-space FVU 1.46); both terms at weight 10 passed the gate at f32_b10 k16 (MAE 0.017, AUROC decrease 0.004, AP decrease 0.004), f32_b10 k32 (0.014, 0.007, 0.004) and f40_b08 k16 (0.019, 0.002, 0.012), at overall FVU 0.57 / 0.48 / 0.57
head_read.monitoring: for this objective the development probability MAE and pooled FVU are reported at each validation; they do not select checkpoints (checkpoint_selection final)
head_read.random_control: random-weight dictionaries keep the token loss only, because the deployed head reads trained-encoder tokens
head_read.reference: downstream-layer reconstruction terms of end-to-end sparse dictionary learning (SAE_e2e+ds), Braun et al. 2024, arXiv 2405.12241 (docs/source_inventory_20260915.json)

head_read_finetune.source: the token-loss dictionary of the same seed, matrix, k and expansion (grid or extension run); for a variant, the token-loss run of that variant
head_read_finetune.training: the head_read loss (both terms at the same weight) for 8,000 steps with the usual warmup and decay, starting from the source dictionary's weights and inactive-feature counters; a variant keeps its token sampling (nodule pool) during fine-tuning
head_read_finetune.screen: as head_read: the reference seed for every (k, weight), then the other 7 seeds for the smallest configuration whose reference seed passes, moving to the next as soon as an evaluated seed fails
head_read_finetune.rule: added 2026-10-22 after the head-read dictionaries trained from scratch passed the gate at f32_b10 k32 with all 8 seeds but kept 46-56 stable features (670-721 with the token loss), and before any fine-tuning run beyond the smokes: for each field site, choose the smallest k, then the smallest weight, at which all 8 fine-tuned seeds pass the gate; fine-tuned dictionaries replace the from-scratch head-read dictionaries for production, which stay recorded as a comparison; the gate is unchanged
head_read_finetune.smoke: f32_b10 seed 2025, weight 3, 8,000 steps: k32 passes (MAE 0.0144, AUROC decrease 0.0054, AP decrease 0.0003; overall FVU 0.193) with every decoder direction keeping cosine >= 0.7 to its start (median 0.945); k16 fails (AUROC decrease 0.0136, AP decrease 0.028)
head_read_finetune.variants: nodule75 and tokens16x are token-loss runs of that variant (48,000 or 192,000 steps) fine-tuned in the same way; random-weight controls keep the token loss only
head_read_finetune.production: a 192,000-step uniform production fine-tunes token-loss runs of 192,000 steps; for seeds 2025-2028 these are the tokens16x runs, whose training is identical (deterministic runs), and seeds 2029-2032 get new token-loss runs

selection.k: per site, the smallest grid k at which all 8 seeds of the uniform dictionaries pass the fixed-classifier gate (and the text-fidelity rule for w20_b16)
selection.k_revision: 2026-10-21, after the grid and w20_b16 evaluations and before any extension or variant result: the k rule first read 'whose reference-seed uniform dictionary passes'; every grid k already has 8 trained seeds, and the quality rule accepts production dictionaries only when all 8 seeds pass, so k is chosen as the smallest value meeting that requirement (w20_b16 k32: reference seed passes, 3 of 8 seeds fail on AP decrease 0.026-0.027)
selection.length: at the chosen k, 192,000 steps replace 48,000 when, over seeds 2025-2028 with stable meaning reappearance in all 3 other seeds, the reference seed's stable features rise by at least 20% and the 192,000-step reference dictionary passes the fixed-classifier gate
selection.length_revision: added 2026-10-23 after the 192,000-step productions were evaluated, the user having delegated this choice: a 192,000-step production replaces the 48,000-step dictionaries only when all its 8 seeds pass the gate (the site's gate, with text fidelity at w20_b16); otherwise the 48,000-step dictionaries of the chosen configuration stay production. Outcome: w20_b16 192,000 steps fail (seed 2032 AP decrease 0.0213) and f32_b10 fail (seed 2031 AUROC decrease 0.0128, mean AP decrease 0.028), so both keep 48,000 steps; f40_b08 192,000 steps pass
selection.pool: user decision 2026-10-15 (option A), applied per site: the nodule-pool variant replaces the uniform dictionaries when all 8 seeds pass the fixed-classifier gate, stable nodule-specific features (nodule enrichment >= 3 on development patients) clearly exceed both the uniform dictionaries and the random-weight control, and stable-feature explained variance at the nodule region exceeds that of the uniform dictionaries
selection.clearly_exceed: at least 1.5 times the comparison count and at least 5 more features (reference seeds)

quality: a site's production dictionaries are accepted for interpretation when all 8 trained seeds pass the fixed-classifier gate (and text fidelity for w20_b16), the reference dictionary reconstructs better than the same-rank PCA, and the reference seed's stable features exceed the random-weight control; otherwise the shortfall is reported with the dictionaries

nodule_coverage.patients: one development record per patient (first identifier in sorted order)
